sources.title: Seemingly Conscious AI is Coming
sources.quote_checked: one that has all the hallmarks of other conscious beings and thus appears to be conscious | This development will be a dangerous turn in AI progress and deserves our immediate attention. | It disconnects people from reality, fraying fragile social bonds and structures, distorting pressing moral priorities. | AI companies shouldn't claim or encourage the idea that their AIs are conscious. | we should build AI that only ever presents itself as an AI | some AI systems will be welfare subjects and moral patients in the near future | This is both premature, and frankly dangerous.

sources.title: Mustafa Suleyman, DeepMind and Inflection Co-founder, joins Microsoft to lead Copilot
sources.quote_checked: Mustafa will be EVP and CEO, Microsoft AI, and joins the senior leadership team (SLT), reporting to me. | a new organization called Microsoft AI, focused on advancing Copilot and our other consumer AI products and research. | Karén is joining this group as Chief Scientist, reporting to Mustafa.

sources.title: Towards Humanist Superintelligence
sources.quote_checked: incredibly advanced AI capabilities that always work for, in service of, people and humanity more generally. | a non-negotiable human-centrism and a commitment to accelerating technological innovation… but in that order. | The order is key. It means proactively avoiding harm and then accelerating. | To do this we have formed the MAI Superintelligence Team, led by me as part of Microsoft AI. | we'll need to contain and align it not just once, but constantly, in perpetuity. | Not an unbounded and unlimited entity with high degrees of autonomy – but AI that is carefully calibrated, contextualized, within limits. | Instead of being designed to beat all humans at all tasks and dominate everything, HSI begins rooted in specific societal challenges that improve human well-being.

sources.title: Reid Hoffman has set up a new AI company with DeepMind's co-founder
sources.quote_checked: Inflection will be led by Suleyman, who will take on the role of CEO.

sources.title: Microsoft hires Inflection founders to run new consumer AI division
sources.quote_checked: They include some of the most accomplished AI engineers, researchers, and builders in the world.
